question: Compare prognostic genes in the HPA TCGA Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma and Lung Adenocarcinoma cohorts. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.
